assets.prompt: Create ONE dedicated horizontal HEAD PORTRAIT for a small game character card. NICOLAS, a 42-year-old male carpenter who learned to fight. Match the FIRST warrior in the reference: same worn angular gray iron helmet, charcoal collar, deep smoky-violet cloth and pragmatic build. For this portrait his HELMET VISOR IS RAISED above his eyebrows so his whole ordinary human face is visible: slightly weathered square face, short brown beard with a few gray hairs, brown eyes and strong uneven nose. A believable tired worker, not a handsome idealized young knight. STYLE must match the attached accepted Eterno Retorno sketchbook: genuine loose graphite/charcoal and muted colored pencil on visible cool-gray PAPER, broken searching pencil lines, cross-hatched shadows, irregular hand coloring, slight eraser marks. Strong charcoal shadows and deep smoky violet pigment, natural restrained skin and hair. NOT photoreal, NOT polished digital rendering, NOT glossy comic art, NOT pixel art. Head turned about 65 degrees to the RIGHT, almost profile but enough far cheek/eye to recognize the face. The FACE and whole head are centered horizontally and vertically, not pushed to an edge. Head and a little upper shoulder only; no hands, weapons, full body, text, badge or border. Wide landscape 2:1 composition. CRITICAL FRAME SAFETY: ENTIRE hair/helmet/head lies inside the middle 60 percent of the canvas height, between 20 and 80 percent; leave empty gray paper above/below, the shoulders may fade into graphite at bottom. The nose, eyes, lips, ear/hair silhouette and jaw must remain clear at small 232x112 display size. The face is the main focus, broad readable values instead of tiny decorative detail. Consistent soft upper-left light. Preserve civilian identity and clothing from the reference, sketchbook imperfections and the black/gray/violet palette.
